latestVersion.changelog:
China Video skill—create and export China-themed videos in the cloud

- First release: easily generate and export 1080p MP4 China travel videos by uploading clips and giving simple instructions.
- Automated setup with support for anonymous cloud authentication (100 free credits, 7-day expiry).
- Handles uploads, editing, adding subtitles/background music, and exports with minimal manual steps.
- Supports multiple video and audio formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, JPG, PNG, MP3, etc.; up to 500MB).
- Error handling covers token expiry, session issues, file limits, lack of credits, and more.
- Optimized workflow for travel vloggers and content creators—quick edit, batch, and iterative styles supported.
